jobs.description:
HEMFRID SÖKER STÄDARE I TYRESÖ – BLI EN DEL AV VÅRT TEAM!
Vill du ha ett jobb där du verkligen gör skillnad i människors vardag? Hemfrid är Sveriges största företag inom hemstädning. Vi hjälper våra kunder med städning, fönsterputs och andra tjänster i hemmet, alltid med kvalitet och omtanke.
Nu söker vi dig som vill arbeta som städare i Tyresö . Hos oss blir du en del av ett internationellt team med kollegor från hela världen, tillsammans levererar vi service i världsklass!
Vad erbjuder vi?
· En tjänst på 75 %
· Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor
· Fast månadslön – samma lön varje månad
· Milersättning mellan kunder för dig som kör egen bil i tjänst
· Betalt restid mellan kunderna
· Försäkringar (sjukdom, ansvar och tjänstepension)
· Vi värnar om din hälsa! Därför erbjuder vi ett friskvårdsbidrag på 2 400 kr per år
· Gratis mobilabonnemang
· Kostnadsfri utbildning i hemstädning samt vidareutbildningar inom service och städning
· Field Lead/Buddy – kontaktperson inom städning samt stöd till medarbetare ute på fältet
· Teamträffar och gemensamma fester
Hos oss får du rätt förutsättningar för att lyckas. Har du viljan, så ger vi dig verktygen för att briljera!

Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig som:
· Tycker om att arbeta både självständigt och i team
· Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och engagerad
· Vill utvecklas och lära dig mer
· Talar svenska eller engelska
· Kan arbeta flexibla arbetstider (måndag–fredag kl. 08.00–17.00)
· Är flexibel och trivs med att arbeta hos olika kunder
Meriterande:
· B-körkort (egen bil är ett plus)
· Erfarenhet av städning eller serviceyrken

Ansök redan idag! Läs mer på www.hemfrid.se/karriar och ansök  Har du frågor? Kontakta oss gärna på hr@hemfrid.se
Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! ✨

HEMFRID IS LOOKING FOR CLEANERS IN TYRESÖ – JOIN OUR TEAM!
Do you want a job where you truly make a difference in people’s everyday lives?
Hemfrid is Sweden’s largest home cleaning company. We help our customers with cleaning, window cleaning, and other home services – always with quality and care.
We are now looking for you who want to work as a cleaner in Tyresö and surrounding areas. With us, you will become part of an international team with colleagues from all over the world. Together, we deliver world-class service!
What do we offer?
· A 75% position
· Collective agreement and secure employment terms
· Fixed monthly salary – the same salary every month
· Mileage compensation between customers if you use your own car for work
· Paid travel time between customers
· Insurance (health, liability, and occupational pension)
· We care about your health! That’s why we offer a wellness allowance of SEK 2,400 per year
· Free mobile phone subscription
· Free training in home cleaning and further education in service and cleaning
· Field Lead/Buddy – point of contact and support for team members in the field on cleaning operations.
· Team meetings and social events
With us, you get the right conditions to succeed. If you have the motivation, we will give you the tools to excel!

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone who:
· Enjoys working both independently and in a team
· Is detail-oriented, responsible, and committed
· Wants to grow and develop
· Speaks Swedish or English
· Can work flexible hours (Monday–Friday between 08:00–17:00)
· Is flexible and enjoys working with different customers
Meritorious:
· B driver’s license (own car is a plus)
· Experience in cleaning or service-related jobs
Apply today! Read more at www.hemfrid.se/karriar and apply  If you have questions, feel free to contact us at hr@hemfrid.se
We look forward to hearing from you! ✨

The opportunity
HVDC is a product group in Hitachi Energy, which develops, manufactures and sells DC transmission systems on a global market. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances and for power transmission via submarine cables. It is also used to connect power systems.
In this exciting role, you are the one who has the knowledge of Project Controls and who is responsible for the planning, scheduling, monitoring and controlling processes of our delivery projects.
This role is based in Västerås or Ludvika, Sweden
How you’ll make an impact
Support the development and maintenance of project baselines, including scope, cost, schedule, resources, and forecasts.
Provide Project and Line Managers with clear project control insights, including schedule, progress, Earned Value Management, productivity, trends, and risks.
Collaborate with project teams to define activities, work and cost breakdown structures, dependencies, and realistic project schedules.
Monitor project progress, critical paths, and milestones, identifying deviations and opportunities to optimize resources.
Partner with functional teams and external parties to develop realistic forecasts, plans, and completion dates.
Prepare and communicate progress reports, schedule updates, forecasts, and productivity data to relevant stakeholders.
Contribute to tendering and project planning activities for HVDC projects.
Review scope, engineering requirements, contractual commitments, responsibilities, and other key inputs to support effective planning and scheduling.

Your background
You hold an Engineering degree in relevant field and have experience of working as a Project Planner in EPC Company or similar
Thorough understanding of logical sequencing and interfacing of project execution activities in EPC energy projects
Experience in planning and cost control on lump sum projects or equivalent and ability to lead project controls activities in multi-location EPC projects
Experience in planning activities and to monitor execution schedules and physical progress in all project phases
Strong communication skills, ability to highlight key issues and to communicate them to management and other stakeholders
Ability to drive project teams to control schedule performance
Analytical skills for forecasting outcomes
Proficiency in English is required for this role
Primavera P6 and Basic cost‑management knowledge expertise is a plus
Experience with HVDC projects will be an added advantage. 

More about us 
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
Group life insurance and additional insurances.​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
Health care and wellness allowance​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
Psychological support program​​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​
Are you ready for a new and exciting opportunity? Does this role sound like a good match for your skills and ambitions? Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply today.

jobs.occupation: Senior Embedded Software Developer, Secure Meters (Sweden) AB
jobs.description:
Are you a skilled Embedded Software Developer with deep experience in Embedded Linux and C programming? Do you want to build solutions for the global energy transition together with an international engineering team?
Secure Meters is looking for an experienced Senior Embedded Software Developer to join the engineering team in Nyköping.
In this role, you will work on innovative and technically challenging projects, developing embedded software solutions and reusable components while exploring emerging technologies. You will collaborate closely with the local Swedish engineering team as well as engineering teams in India.
Location: Nyköping, Sweden (Hybrid, minimum 3 days per week on-site).
The Role
As a Senior Embedded Software Developer at Secure Meters, you play a key part in designing and delivering high-quality software for advanced energy measurement and grid management systems. You take ownership of technical challenges from concept to deployment, working with modern toolchains and automated testing to ensure reliability and scalability.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain embedded software solutions, primarily using Embedded Linux.
Contribute to overall system architecture and software design.
Develop portable, reusable software components and evaluate new technologies through prototypes and proof-of-concept projects.
Write high-quality, efficient and maintainable code supported by automated testing.
Collaborate with engineering teams in Sweden and India to deliver innovative technical solutions.
Participate actively in technical discussions, code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Keep up to date with emerging technologies, industry trends and best practices in embedded systems.
Continuously develop technical skills and share expertise through team meetings, workshops and mentoring.

Qualifications & Experience
You may currently work in a role such as:
Senior Embedded Software Developer
Embedded Linux Engineer
Firmware Engineer
Embedded Systems Architect

Essential requirements:
Minimum 6 years of professional embedded software development experience.
Bachelor's degree (BSc) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
Strong hands-on experience with Embedded Linux.
High proficiency in C programming.
Solid understanding of system architecture and software design principles.
Demonstrated experience in writing portable and reusable code, verified by automated testing.
Hands-on experience using Git daily in modern team workflows.
Practical experience with JTAG/SWD or remote debugging techniques.
Experience with developing, integrating and utilizing open-source software packages.
Experience with Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines and modern build workflows.
Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written).

Desirable experience:
Experience working with RTOS (Real-Time Operating Systems).
Domain background in power grids, energy management, smart metering or industrial data acquisition.
Experience building rapid prototypes and evaluating emerging hardware/software technologies.
Conversational or professional Swedish is an advantage.

Personal Attributes
To thrive in this role, we believe you are:
Innovative, curious and open-minded, with a genuine interest in exploring new technologies.
A technical problem-solver who takes ownership of challenges and proactively drives solutions.
Comfortable working in an international, collaborative and supportive team environment.
Driven by a continuous learning mindset, eager to develop and share knowledge with colleagues.
Adaptable to evolving project requirements, technologies and engineering practices.

About Secure Meters
Secure Meters is a global provider of advanced solutions for measuring, monitoring and managing energy consumption. With more than 7,200 employees across 10 countries, we are a leading player in the energy sector, partnering with utilities and businesses to create sustainable, efficient and innovative solutions for electricity distribution and transmission. Our products are deployed in over 70 countries, helping customers make better, data-driven decisions about their energy use. Through continuous engineering innovation and customer focus, we remain at the forefront of the industry.
To learn more about our business and how we drive progress in the energy sector, visit www.securemeters.com to explore our solutions and our commitment to a sustainable future.
We welcome you to join our engineering team in Nyköping and contribute to Secure Meters' continued growth and technology leadership!
Application
We collaborate with Addilon in this recruitment. Please submit your application (CV and cover letter in English) as soon as possible via the link below. The selection process is ongoing and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. 
And we need people like you to make it happen.
We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.
Job Summary
The Technical Support Excellence team is part of the Tetra Pak Service organisation. We are ambassadors of Tetra Pak to help maintain the company’s reputation and commitment for services and quality worldwide.
 
We are now looking for an enthusiastic and customer-oriented Commissioning Specialist focus on Processing Liquid Food Solutions Branded Processing Units (BPU) to join our team.
We can offer you a very interesting position and an opportunity to grow and become professional in one of our core technologies for food processing.
 
This is a permanent position based in Lund, Sweden and will include up to 150 traveling days as our customers are located all over the world.
What you will do
Most of your work tasks will be executed at our customers’ plants, following Tetra Pak processes and procedures, which also gives you the opportunity to be an ambassador for the company. Your main task will be to commission and perform troubleshooting on our solutions, both our branded processing units and complete process lines at end-customer’s factories all over the world.
 
Main responsibilities:
Commissioning, start-up and troubleshooting of branded processing units and process lines at our customer’s sites
Execute analysis and troubleshoot to resolve automation and electrical issues.
Document your findings in technical reports
Participate in building good relationships with customer staff and colleagues in our Market Companies
Execute all work in accordance with Tetra Pak and Customer safety regulations and requirements and promote a safe working culture in the team

We believe you have
At least a secondary school education with technical orientation, high knowledgeable in automation including PLC knowledge and understanding of mechatronics, which includes electrical and mechanical interaction within the application
Hands-on experience resolving technical issues at customer sites
A good command of both written and verbal English is necessary
Knowledge of other languages will be a plus
Knowledge on processing equipment in the food industry will be considered as an advantage
Driving license

 
To be successful in this position we believe you are a curious, self-motivated person with a high degree of initiative. You will work autonomously in complex situations, having the ability to make your own fast decisions and to solve problems under time and customer pressure.
Furthermore, you are structured and enjoy to coach others and solve problems with the best solution for all parts in mind. You have strong interest in technology and are happy to take on operational roles and technical hands-on activities.
We Offer You
A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

 
Apply Now
If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/. 
This job posting expires on 2026.12.10

Company description:
Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.
Job description: Join our team   
As a Production Quality Engineer, you play a key role in shaping the quality, reliability, and safe performance of our products. You will be at the forefront of ensuring that every product leaving our production facilities meets and exceeds customer expectations, while contributing to a safe, efficient, and world-class manufacturing environment. 
 This is more than a quality role. It is an opportunity to make a visible impact on our products, processes, and future technologies. By driving quality excellence and safety improvements, and reducing disturbances throughout the production flow, you will directly influence customer satisfaction, operational performance, and business success. 
 Your mission 
 In the role as Production Quality Engineer, you will contribute and support the organization to exceed customer´s expectations with safe products and components with the right quality and highest reliability.  
 You will inspire and contribute to efficient and disruption-free production from a safety and quality perspective. Cross-functional collaboration with several different departments regarding quality issues.
   
Be part of and contribute to the daily work and improvement work within the Production Quality department. 
 
    
Advanced troubleshooting during quality disturbances with a high focus on new technology e.g. electrification.  
 
    
Investigate and forward feedback. 
 
    
To be a case holder during advanced quality deviations and perform root cause analysis. 
 
    
Develop and review quality processes. 
 
    
In connection with quality outcomes from field, product audits and testing. Evaluate, educate, implement and follow-up on improvements. 
 
    
Takes ownership to prevent future deviations using risk analyses, Lean principles, create and manage data collection and 6 sigma methodology. 
 
    
Perform module inspection. 
 
  
 Your profile
 To thrive as a Quality Engineer, you are a team player capable of handling multiple tasks simultaneously. Your curiosity about new technology and a thoughtful and structured approach allows you to think innovatively and show initiative. Flexibility is key, and you enjoy building and maintaining an extensive network both internally and externally. A service-oriented mindset is second nature to you, and you see stimulating tasks as opportunities rather than limitations.  
   
You have a technical university degree or equivalent work experience and a strong interest in technology.  
 
    
Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and Word, 
 
    
Experience working in M3 and Teamcenter, along with other quality tools, is highly desirable.  
 
    
With excellent proficiency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written, you can communicate smoothly within our global network.  
 
  
 
 Your experience in quality and assembly, coupled with in-depth knowledge of our products, makes you an ideal candidate for the role. 
  
 Location and other 
 This position is located in Örebro, Sweden. Occasional travel is required.  
  
 Why Epiroc? 
 By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact. 
  
 To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:  
   
Global career opportunities 
 
    
Learning & Development programs 
 
    
Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus) 
 
    
Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being 
 
    
Global Parental Leave Policy 
 
  
 
 Application and contact information 
 We encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than December 3. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date.
 For questions about the position, please contact: 
 Hiring Manager, Gustav Scholander, Gustav.scholander@epiroc.com 
 Recruitment specialist, Martin Liljeholm, martin.liljeholm@external.epiroc.com

Are you a back-end developer who enjoys building software that connects with real-world industrial hardware – from forklifts in warehouses to charging systems in ports? Do you like being involved in the full journey, from problem definition to production, and care about creating open, secure and reusable solutions? Then we have a great opportunity for you.
We make electrification of the industry a reality.
Micropower is an international company headquartered in Växjö, Sweden. With strong in-house expertise, we develop and produce efficient, intelligent lithium-ion batteries, charging systems, and power converters. We operate in Sweden, the USA, Germany, Finland, Italy. 
What you'll do 
In this role you design and implement scalable back-end services in Python and Go, and model and optimise data in MongoDB. You build the services and APIs that connect our cloud platform with physical energy hardware in the field. Our services are primarily containerised, and you help deploy, monitor and maintain our self-hosted systems. You own features end-to-end and collaborate across functions with product, sales and support.
You will join a small, product-driven team developing open, secure solutions for the energy industry. With open source at the core of everything we build, we prioritise transparency, reusability, integrity and adherence to open standards. As we are a small team, you will also support other areas which gives you a great opportunity to widen your competence.
The GET team builds and operates the GET Fleet Management System – a containerised cloud and mobile platform that connects to physical energy hardware. The team works closely with Product, Sales and Service to drive the development of open-source energy solutions.
The position is based in Växjö and you will report to Global Software Manager. 
What you’ll get 
A key role in a fast-growing, innovative company where your creativity and ideas have a real impact.  
A dynamic, development-driven environment with great opportunities for professional growth.  
Collaboration across functions, in an international environment. 
Work with cutting-edge technology in a culture that values initiative, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/IT or equivalent demonstrated work experience
Around 3–6 years of experience building cloud-based software in a production environment
Solid experience with Python and/or Go in a production environment
Practical experience with MongoDB or other document databases, including data modelling, indexing and scaling
Experience designing and building APIs and back-end services
Experience deploying and maintaining self-hosted systems (Docker, Kubernetes or similar container orchestration; configuration management; monitoring and logging)
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken

We also value
experience with React or other modern front-end frameworks
experience with IoT, device communication or systems that integrate with hardware

Who you are
A person who is genuinely interested in programming, high-quality results, and maintainable code. You are driven and curious, and you take ownership of your work from problem to production. You enjoy a small, autonomous team and care about the experience your work creates for the end user. Transparency in communication with colleagues across functions – including people outside engineering – is a given for you, and you value open standards and reusable solutions. Change motivates you and you welcome challenges. You solve problems by communicating with others, driving your own development and delivering good results.
Our core principles of presence and responsibility guide us as we progress with dedication and sincerity.  At Micropower we fuel people to power growth. 
Join us in the exciting journey to a more sustainable future!

jobs.occupation: Senior Associate – Legal and Business Affairs - Media and Entertainment Law
jobs.description:
Senior Associate – Legal and Business Affairs - Media and Entertainment
Jefferson Saleh is a boutique legal and business affairs consultancy (organised as a Swedish juristbyrå) serving the UK media, entertainment and creative industries. We advise across the full lifecycle of creative content, from development and financing to production, exploitation and licensing, including talent deals, IP strategy, clearances and generative AI. We also provide legal operations and back-office support.
Our clients are primarily based in the UK and US and range from creators and talent to production companies, agencies, financiers and international studios, across film, television, digital, branded and emerging media. 

The Role 
We are seeking an experienced English-qualified solicitor to advise clients primarily on film and TV development and production. The role is suitable for a service-minded candidate who is comfortable leading complex talent negotiations with UK and US talent agents and lawyers, managing high-profile client relationships and advising on production, financing, talent and commercial matters. The candidate should enjoy solving unconventional problems, have a healthy appetite for risk and want to help shape a small but growing consultancy.
The successful candidate will work with a high degree of autonomy alongside senior client stakeholders, producers, financiers, talent representatives and other client legal teams, often across multiple jurisdictions. 

Our Values 
We prioritise speed, quality, trust, commercially meaningful advice and long-term relationships. How we work matters as much as the work itself. Our clients operate in fast-moving environments and expect responsive, available and pragmatic advisers who understand both the legal and commercial sides of a deal. 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities 
Managing the production legal workflow: drafting, reviewing and negotiating talent (writer, director, producer) agreements, PSAs, development and format agreements, finance documentation, distribution and licensing deals, crew and HOD contracts, rights acquisition and chain of title documentation, brand partnership and sponsorship arrangements and other copyright-based agreements.  
Advising on: financing structures, guild and collective bargaining agreements, broadcasting code clearance, production risk, cultural tests and tax incentives 
Managing: transactions and negotiations from inception to delivery 
Acting as: a day-to-day contact for clients and counterparties 
Supporting: business development initiatives 
Supervising: junior lawyers and/or trainees where appropriate

Essential Minimum Requirements  
Qualified solicitor in England & Wales (Australian or US qualified considered if experienced working in the UK market)
At least 5 years’ PQE working with transactional entertainment/media law, primarily advising film and television clients
Experience independently managing film/TV production legals 
Excellent grasp of contractual risk allocation 
Private practice experience or a desire to work in a client-facing role
Understanding of the practical applications of Pact, Equity and BECTU rules
Excellent written and spoken legal English

Desirable Experience 
Understanding of how the UK guild landscape interacts with SAG, WGA and DGA
Understanding of US studio practices and priorities
Ability to negotiate against LA-based acting talent representatives
Working on studio or SVOD commissioned production legals 
Production financing and security arrangements 
AI issues affecting the entertainment industry 
Understanding of GDPR and Data Privacy laws

 
About You  
Proactive and capable of taking ownership
Commercially pragmatic and solutions-focused 
Collaborative and team-oriented 
Interest in the entertainment industry 
Puts clients’ needs first 

Working Arrangements
Full-time in Härryda, Gothenburg, Sweden.

Salary
Gross SEK 60,000–79,000 per month. Where an offer sits within the range will depend on a number of factors, including PQE, depth of film and TV production experience, US talent negotiation experience, level of guild understanding, ability to work without supervision, any existing client relationships and the level of responsibility the successful candidate is able to take on from day one.

Other Benefits
Occupational pension (tjänstepension) 
Private health insurance
Bicycle scheme via salary exchange (förmånscykel)
Discretionary annual bonus scheme
Salary top-up during parental leave based on years of service 
Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) at or near the tax-free maximum
25 days’ paid annual holiday plus Swedish public holidays
Paid professional annual practising certificate renewal with the SRA 

Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

The opportunity
We’re looking for a motivated individual to join our Marketing and Logistics Team. If you're passionate about customer service and operational excellence, this role offers a dynamic environment where you’ll manage offer, order, processing, fulfilment, dispatch, and payment support. You’ll play a key role in ensuring smooth order flow and high customer satisfaction through timely and accurate execution.
Step into the heart of cutting-edge power technology at Hitachi Energy’s High Power Laboratory in Ludvika, Sweden. The Laboratory is a large test facility for high voltage products with a variety of non-routine electrical and mechanical test procedures. Its main purpose is to perform high quality testing, both in the development of new products, and in certification of the products for the global market. The laboratory is accredited by SWEDAC as an independent testing body for many different standards and norms.
This position is with placement in Ludvika, Sweden.
How you’ll make an impact
Management of requests and services to internal and external clients, ensuring a seamless experience from offer to delivery.
Ensure accuracy and timeliness of offers by reviewing incoming requests for completeness, entering them promptly, monitoring progress, and resolving issues in line with company standards to maintain high customer satisfaction.
Support customers with entering requests, processing, and fulfillment, making sure all steps are handled accurately and efficiently.
Assist with order-related documentation, including invoicing and payment follow-up, to support smooth financial transactions.

Experience with CANoe, CANoe, and CANalyzer for CAN bus, LIN, and Ethernet testing.

About us
Hacksaw Studios is a Stockholm-based game studio focused on creating innovative, high-quality gaming experiences. With a focus on performance and precision, we bring ideas to life through technical expertise and creative collaboration. We have wide distribution, and our games are played by millions of people every month by players all over the world.
We are now looking for a Recruitment Partner to join our team in Stockholm in early 2027 for a one-year temporary position, covering for a colleague during their absence, with the possibility of transitioning to permanent employment.. In this role, you will manage recruitment across technical, creative, and business roles, working closely with hiring managers and our HR Manager to bring great people into our teams.
The Role
You will take ownership of recruitment from the initial hiring brief through to a well-prepared start for each new colleague, combining proactive sourcing with close collaboration across the business. You will help hiring managers make informed decisions, keep recruitment processes moving, and ensure candidates feel informed and supported throughout. This requires curiosity about our business and the different professions within it, along with the ability to turn changing hiring needs into clear priorities and timely action.
Your key responsibilities include:
Managing end-to-end recruitment processes across technical, creative, and business roles.
Partnering with hiring managers to define hiring needs, role requirements, and candidate profiles, and plan recruitment timelines around team capacity and intended start dates.
Proactively sourcing and approaching talent, including highly specialised roles, building relationships with candidates for current and future opportunities.
Advising hiring managers on interview structure, candidate evaluation, and hiring decisions.
Coordinating interviews, gathering feedback, and ensuring clear and timely communication throughout each process.
Working closely with the HR Manager to align recruitment priorities with business needs.
Coordinating preparations for new starters with hiring managers, HR, and relevant colleagues to ensure practical arrangements and onboarding plans are in place.
Maintaining accurate and up-to-date recruitment systems, documentation, and reporting.
Identifying and driving improvements to recruitment processes, tools, and ways of working.

What We’re Looking For
Experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment processes.
Experience sourcing and approaching candidates, including for specialist roles.
The ability to build strong relationships with hiring managers and act as a trusted recruitment partner, adapting your communication to different roles, perspectives, and levels of the organisation.
Sound judgment when assessing candidates and supporting hiring decisions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
A structured and proactive approach, with the ability to manage several recruitment processes and shifting priorities.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn about different professions, technologies, and teams to understand what makes someone successful in each role.
Confidence in taking initiative, constructively challenging established ways of working, and bringing people together around improvements.
A thoughtful approach to candidate experience, with clear communication and consistent follow-through.
Professionalism, discretion, and care when handling confidential information.

Nice to Have
Experience recruiting within gaming, iGaming, or tech.
Experience recruiting across technical, creative, and business disciplines.
Experience working in a growing organization with changing hiring needs.
Experience improving recruitment processes and working with applicant tracking systems.
Proficiency in Swedish.

What We Offer
A modern office in central Stockholm.
The opportunity to work with experienced and passionate colleagues in the gaming industry.
The chance to help build the teams behind games played by a global audience.
Real influence, ownership, and opportunities for personal and professional growth.
Wellbeing benefits, including a wellness allowance and regular in-office massages.

Practical Details
Start date: Early 2027, for a one-year temporary position with the possibility of transitioning to permanent employment.
This is a temporary cover position, with the possibility of extension.
This is an on-site position in Stockholm.
Unfortunately, we cannot assist with relocation or visa sponsorship.

Ready to Join the Game Makers?
Apply now! We review applications on a rolling basis.
